name: Class buffs: support haste buffs replace each other, haste cooldowns and banners stay
contract: Maintainer decision 2026-11-22 (PR #13237 review): a buff of five minutes or longer keeps one per stat
across classes; a shorter buff whose tooltip says it does not stack with similar effects is a support buff
and keeps one per stat among support buffs; every other shorter buff is a cooldown, has no CoA class
category and stacks with everything. Tailwind 804035 (Stormbringer, class 16, 15 seconds, raid area aura)
and Horn of Alacrity 806360 (Ranger, class 21, 30 seconds, party and raid members) give
SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS and SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE, base points 4: +5% each, and their tooltips
say they do not stack with similar effects: spell_group 2113008 (rule 1, SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE)
holds both. Hasten 801304 (Chronomancer, class 22) is a cooldown. Banner of Swiftness 500259 (Guardian,
class 18) keeps its raid area aura 800704 up without end, so it is an aura, and no other class has that
signature. Expected: on a grouped ally Horn of Alacrity replaces Tailwind, while Hasten and the Banner of
Swiftness aura stay beside Horn of Alacrity.

steps.label: The Guardian attaches the Banner of Swiftness

DISCRIMINATING: support haste buffs keep one, so Horn of Alacrity replaced Tailwind
Give a replacement time to remove either aura
DISCRIMINATING: Hasten leaves Horn of Alacrity in place
DISCRIMINATING: Horn of Alacrity leaves Hasten in place
DISCRIMINATING: the Banner of Swiftness aura stays beside the support buff and the cooldown
